verdict.rationale: Abacum's own Excel connector lets users push and pull data between Abacum and Excel, which is a first-party way to get data out. It is framed as an ongoing sync workflow, not a complete data-export or exit path, and no other export mechanism is documented (the OpenAPI probe found nothing). Missing for 10: documented full-workspace bulk export, explicit open formats (CSV/JSON), export of models, logic and audit history, an offboarding/data-portability policy, and independent corroboration.
